final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS c FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.college_id, s1.c AS c, s1.c * 1.0 / s2.tot AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.college_id, s3.c AS c, s3.ratio AS ratio, s3.c - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.a) SELECT AVG(c), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5
